page.help: See which invite each member joined through: counts per inviter, a leaderboard, roles for reaching an invite count, and {inviter} in welcome messages. Off by default.

support.title: Not in the support server
support.text: Invite tracking runs in the main server and in other servers, not in Mewvo's support server.

permission.title: Mewvo needs Manage Server
permission.text: Without the Manage Server permission Mewvo cannot read the invite list, so no join can be matched to an invite. Give Mewvo's role Manage Server in Server Settings → Roles.

settings.title: Invite tracking
settings.help: Turn it on, and choose when a join counts as fake. Fake joins are left out of the counts; changing the rule recounts everything.
settings.enabledHelp: Mewvo notes which invite each new member used.
settings.fakeDaysHelp: A member whose Discord account is younger than this when they join counts as fake. 0 turns this off.
settings.fakeHoursHelp: A member who leaves within this time after joining counts as fake. 0 turns this off.

milestones.title: Milestone roles
milestones.help: Give a role when someone reaches an invite count (up to 10). A role stays when the count drops later.
milestones.stackHelp: Off: only the highest reached role is kept.
milestones.incomplete: Step {n} needs both a count and a role.
milestones.sameCount: Two steps use {count} invites. Each step needs its own count.
milestones.sameRole: Two steps use the same role. Each step needs its own role.

unreadable: Could not be read right now (database not responding).

board.title: Leaderboard
board.help: Total = joined − left − fake + bonus. Rejoins through the same inviter count once.
board.resetAt: Counts start from the reset on

recent.title: Latest joins
recent.help: The last 20 joins and how each member came in.

codes.title: Invite codes
codes.help: The server's invites, most used first.
codes.creator: Created by
codes.loading: The invite list is loading. Joins right now are recorded as unknown.

commands.title: Commands
commands.text: Everyone: /invites view and /invites leaderboard. Administrators: /invites who, list, bonus add or remove, reset (with a confirm button) and setup.
